title: MARKOPOLIS
description: MAC's premier inter-college marketing and business strategy simulation. Featuring high-stakes bidding wars, crisis PR rooms, and industry keynote seminars designed to push analytical limits.

editions.title: MARKOPOLIS 2026
editions.subtitle: THE ASYMMETRIC MONOPOLY
editions.caption: Markopolis 2026 convened 500+ top collegiate delegations across 20+ universities to battle in live corporate crisis rooms, hostile takeover bids, and unit economics auctions.
editions.winner: WINNER: SRCC // RUNNER UP: HINDU COLLEGE

editions.title: MARKOPOLIS 2025
editions.subtitle: DISRUPTION & SCALE

editions.title: MARKOPOLIS 2024
